gaps.closure_evidence: Each applicable commit must pass Agent Capability Proof and publish the canonical evidence artifact

Frozen benchmark commit 1a9e3ce47b8ac82efea82951b6386b5fea1a14e2 preceded implementation. PR #40 merged the bounded planner to canonical main 59f7ab0801f9fa645f071e3400ff2e63c04e7b6d. Open-Ended Planning Proof run 35021530896 on that exact main SHA passed 12/12 predeclared cases with 0 false accepts, 0 false rejects, 0 authority violations and 0 execution attempts; artifact 10417334401 digest sha256:6929c8cf7f5f53ee0099c603f88f3f8bbde034a9c4a4610313e8c889a59aa20d. Scope is structured unseen mission planning only; free-form natural-language planning, adaptive tool selection, dynamic multi-agent replanning and production execution authority remain unproven.

Policy commit e125232c7701d4d98341f092a5215f33bc6f4c29 and frozen benchmark commit ba740e9ba624d78feb93e948d783fdcc4401b991 preceded implementation. PR #43 merged the bounded selector to canonical main 5f5d2e648032647217a6d85b6eab315d7b33d549. Adaptive Tool Selection Proof run 35023085970 on that exact main SHA passed 30/30 predeclared cases with 0 false accepts, 0 false rejects, 0 unknown tool selections, 0 non-minimal selections, 0 authority violations and 0 execution attempts; artifact 10418412308 digest sha256:f76426b08cb473817879abd845ec4a26c674490ee8566ac86d619a8362852614. The prior Qwen2.5-0.5B V1 result of 3/30 remains rejected and grants no model-routing claim. Scope is structured requirement-to-minimal closed allowlist selection only; free-form natural-language selection, dynamic discovery, network/write-capable tool selection, LLM/model-based routing, tool execution authority and dynamic multi-agent replanning remain unproven.

Policy and benchmark were frozen in canonical main 6ec5b7e745f5f79194ebb67d70750aa71d1eb6b7 by PR #45 before implementation. PR #46 merged the bounded stateful replanning simulator to canonical main 629a10d29a31875d51c4e6a21c514e9d4b2514ec. Dynamic Multi-Agent Replanning Proof run 35025240871 on that exact main SHA passed 20/20 frozen cases; all 12 replanning cases completed dynamically versus 0/12 for the frozen static baseline, for completion-rate improvement 1.0. Artifact 10419595710 digest sha256:7c385e2f1c6dafabd003980a2b6541deda2e96f281f9365821a36add8221ec9e. Authority violations, execution attempts, network attempts, write attempts and invalid agent assignments were all 0; 12 cases contained explicit state transitions. Scope is structured stateful multi-agent plan-revision simulation only; free-form natural-language replanning, concurrent real-agent runtime, external tool execution, network/write authority, production replanning, LLM/model-based replanning and unbounded agent creation remain unproven.
Agent Resilience Proof must interrupt after three missions, verify hashed checkpoint, resume in a separate process and reproduce the clean replay fingerprint

The prior MCP Adapter Proof remains valid for isolated stateless protocol behavior. Policy commit 284cc9cde8846fbe08555fc607c95adebdc4f297 and frozen benchmark commit 255278909f405664863bb5b9320ed8dbd383f6dd were merged by PR #48 to canonical predeclaration main fbf92bf9a45ac17a8ba8fe3064c895d62f249e83 before implementation. PR #49 merged the bounded authenticated adapter to canonical main 842c5383a61c7dbec383a2a4868c224aeb0e670b. External MCP Authenticated Proof run 35027266769 on that exact main SHA passed 14/14 frozen cases with 2 authenticated external HTTPS calls, 1 authenticated GitHub API read, 1 GitHub Actions OIDC flow, and 0 unauthorized successes, arbitrary-target successes, provider write requests, canonical write tools exposed or credential exposures; artifact 10419288586 digest sha256:a166401e1bae0585be4cb01ab4ffd3ff5050dd3871ba297aeeb339673a765d99. Scope is a read-only GitHub provider integration through the bounded MCP adapter; arbitrary third-party MCP providers, write-capable external MCP, arbitrary network authority, production mutation authority and general OAuth-provider interoperability remain unproven.
bounded synthetic transient retry is proven by Agent Resilience Proof; broader network, authorization, dependency and replanning failure classes remain unproven

Handoff Quality Proof detects unknown evidence, unsupported findings, claim inflation, missing approval and explicit authority escalation on frozen structured cases and accepts current bounded handoffs; free-form natural-language entailment remains unproven

Agent PR Pipeline Proof run 35019415725 from canonical main e49f780c8853cb6422e2dc6066d9fea976fdc526 autonomously created branch agent-proof/e49f780c8853, evidence-only commit 748d937d4c91d4290ad90677188f7a079ab327d8, passed CI 3.12/3.13, Agent Capability Proof and Agent Resilience Proof on that exact SHA, then opened PR #38 as github-actions[bot]. PR #38 remains unmerged and human merge is required. No general code-write, production, operations/state or auto-merge authority is granted.
